title: Models and services that generate 3D content (meshes, textures, rigs, motion, worlds, CAD, molecule meshes) and whether they run locally
notes: Scope: which models and services make 3D content, which have open weights, which can run on the CPU server (Linux, 76 CPU cores, 503 GB RAM, no GPU, usually busy) and on an 8 GB laptop GPU (RTX 4060 Laptop). Verdict rules: home_srv and laptop_gpu_8gb are 'unknown' unless a source says it; no source gave a CPU speed for any mesh generator except 'very slow' for SPAR3D and trellis.cpp, so no model is marked 'yes' for the CPU server. min_vram_gb is null when no page states a figure. Licence type rule: OSI licences (MIT, Apache, GPL) are open-source; custom, non-commercial and gated licences (Tencent community, Stability community, S-Lab, NVIDIA NC, CC BY-NC, SAM, OpenRAIL, Hi3D, Apple) are source-available; services are proprietary. Pages were read through a page-fetch tool that summarises, so each entry is marked as read from README or model card.

entries.name: Stable Fast 3D (SF3D)

licence.name: Stability AI Community License (free below US$1M annual revenue)

capabilities.does: API makes a mesh from text, from one image or from several images; 3D tasks start at 20 credits; the page names the Meshy 7 model series.
AI texturing task for an existing model, priced by resolution, with 8K listed.
Auto-rigging (5 credits) and animation (3 credits) tasks, plus a remesh task (5 credits).

outcomes: game and print props from prompts

entries.name: Tripo (API v3)

licence.name: credit-based API; prices and output rights not on the page read

capabilities.does: Generation endpoints for text, one image and several views, each with H Series and P Series variants; tasks are queued and polled.
Texture, convert, semantic segment, mesh completion and decimate (retopology) endpoints work on an existing model.
The Animation group of the v3 API has three endpoints: rig-check (rigging compatibility), rig (rig a model) and retarget (retarget an animation). The page gives no detail on skeleton or skinning.

rea.notes: Cloud only. The vendor's TripoSR and TripoSG models are open (see those entries). The main site returned 403 to the page fetch.

entries.name: Rodin (Hyper3D)

licence.name: free credits then paid tiers; prices not shown on the page

capabilities.does: Makes 3D models from text or reference images with clean topology and PBR materials with UVs; the page lists Gen-2.5, Remix and Turbo options and exports to STL, FBX, OBJ, GLB, GLTF and USDZ.
Bounding box, voxel and point cloud ControlNets steer the shape; an editing area offers Parts, Refine and Modify for uploaded OBJ, FBX or GLB files.

rea.notes: Cloud only, with an API platform and plugins for Blender, Unity, Unreal, Godot, Maya and 3ds Max. The page does not say whether any weights are open.

entries.name: Sloyd

licence.name: free start, commercial licence included in plans; plan terms not shown

capabilities.does: Hundreds of customisable templates with a Template Editor that also takes text prompts; the page claims game-ready output with polygon targets and quad topology, and watertight models for printing.
A 3D generation API takes text or images with control over polygon count and texture resolution and a job-status endpoint; plugins exist for Blender, Godot, Maya, Roblox, Unity and Unreal.

rea.notes: Cloud only. The page does not mention LODs or UVs.

entries.name: 3D AI Studio

licence.name: subscriptions from US$12/month billed annually, credit packs, pay-as-you-go API

capabilities.does: One site fronting 20+ 3D generators, among them TRELLIS 2, Hitem3D 3.0, Rodin Gen-2.5, Tripo P2, Hunyuan3D 3.1, Meshy 7.1 and Prism 3.1. The FAQ says fast models finish in under 90 seconds. Its export lists vary: GLB, FBX, OBJ, STL, 3MF, USDZ, BLEND, DAE.
Quad remeshing, AI texturing, segmentation, GLB compression and format conversion tools work on uploaded models.
Auto-rigging is listed as a tool, with an MCP connector for Claude and ChatGPT and a REST API.

rea.notes: Cloud only. It lists Hunyuan3D 3.1, so the Hunyuan 3D 3.x line is reachable through hosted services, but no open weights for 3.x were found.

entries.name: Kaedim

licence.name: pricing not shown; customers are said to own their custom assets

capabilities.does: Turns sketches, concept art, product photos and briefs into 3D assets for games, product design and e-commerce, with turnaround of hours.
A review, mark-up, iterate and approve loop with unlimited revisions; the page does not say whether human artists are involved.

rea.notes: Cloud only; the case-study numbers on the page are self-reported.
